name: Wartribe Academy
source:
You play the prince of a small tribe of warriors that has recently gained great renown. Your father uses that renown to marry you into an alliance consisting of 9 city states. Each city sends one of their noble daughters to be your bride, but they all have their own agenda! Meet up with them at your own Academy and get to know the various pretty nobles. But be careful, your father warns you that one of these families is responsible for your mother's death!

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/wartribeacademy]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你是一支近期声名鹊起的小型战士部族的王子。父亲利用这份声望，通过你的婚事，与一个由九座城邦组成的联盟缔结关系。每座城市都派来一位贵族千金，准备成为你的新娘，但她们各有打算！在你自己的学院里与她们见面，了解这些美丽的贵族。不过请当心，父亲提醒你，这些家族中，有一家正是杀害母亲的凶手！

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/wartribeacademy]Patreon[/url]]
